directAnswer: You can connect a printer to WiFi by using the printer's control panel to select your network and enter the password.
summary: Connecting a printer to WiFi allows for wireless printing from multiple devices. The process may vary based on the printer model.

sections.heading: Network Setup
sections.body: Most modern printers have a setup wizard that guides you through connecting to your WiFi network. Ensure your printer is powered on and within range of your WiFi router.

sections.heading: Using WPS
sections.body: If your router supports WPS (WiFi Protected Setup), you can connect your printer by pressing the WPS button on your router and then selecting WPS on your printer.

sections.heading: Manual Connection
sections.body: For printers without WPS, access the printer's control panel, navigate to the network settings, select your WiFi network, and enter the password manually.

steps.title: Access the Printer Menu
steps.detail: On the printer's control panel, navigate to the 'Settings' or 'Network' menu.

steps.title: Select WiFi Setup
steps.detail: Choose 'Wireless Setup Wizard' or 'WiFi Setup' depending on your printer model.

steps.title: Choose Your Network
steps.detail: From the list of available networks, select your WiFi network.

steps.title: Enter Password
steps.detail: Input your WiFi password when prompted and confirm the connection.

faqs.question: What if my printer doesn't have a display?
faqs.answer: If your printer lacks a display, refer to the manufacturer's manual for instructions on connecting via a computer or mobile app.

faqs.question: Can I connect multiple devices to the same printer?
faqs.answer: Yes, once the printer is connected to WiFi, multiple devices can connect to it as long as they are on the same network.

faqs.question: What should I do if my printer won't connect?
faqs.answer: Ensure your WiFi network is operational, check the printer's compatibility with your router, and restart both the printer and router if necessary.

caveats: Some older printer models may not support WiFi connections and require a USB connection instead.
